project.name: 2425 Team
project.description: Search-and-rescue sensing device. Senior design team hub for decisions, links, and delivery dates.

decisions.decision: Selected ESP32-S3 as the primary compute board for sensing and telemetry.
decisions.reason: Wi-Fi and BLE on board, dual-core headroom for fusion, lowest cost risk for a prototype.

decisions.decision: First validation test scoped to outdoor rubble and light indoor spaces.
decisions.reason: Fits the semester while still stressing multipath and occlusion.

decisions.decision: Use Kanban with a weekly status freeze instead of formal sprints.
decisions.reason: Works better with five subsystems, uneven lab access, and part lead times.

decisions.decision: Primary sensing pair is thermal plus IMU. Acoustic is a stretch goal.
decisions.reason: Thermal is useful for SAR demos. Acoustic needs more DSP time than we can guarantee.

glossary.definition: Combining readings from more than one sensor so the result is more reliable than any single source. Here that means thermal, IMU, and ranging data into one picture.
How often the detector reports a victim or hazard when none is there. We track it in validation because noisy alerts waste rescuer time.
Sending device health and sensing outputs to an operator view. Wi-Fi first, with local buffering when the link drops.
Bill of materials: the full parts list with quantities and costs. We freeze it before each order so spending stays clear.
